# On-screen layout

**How is the 9:16 frame divided?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## Full-frame face with pop-up labels
<a id="full-face"></a>

Waist-up or face full frame, with short labels popping over the chest and punch-ins on emphasis.

**Looks like:** You fill the frame talking; 'HEATER' pops in yellow over your chest and a punch-in lands on the punchline.

**Good at:** personality; trust; fast to make

**Weak at:** less to look at; needs strong delivery

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, story · niches all · goals trust, follows, speed · effort low

**How:** Tripod at eye level; labels and zoom keyframes in Edits/CapCut.

**Backed by:** [Switch layouts every few seconds](../topics/editing.md#edit-layout-switching), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Yellow caps labels and big ₹ figures](../topics/text.md#text-yellow-condensed-labels), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face), [UI and text pops: spring with slight overshoot](../topics/effects.md#fx-spring-ui) · sources R1, L06

## Framed graphic yap
<a id="framed-graphic"></a>

Frame yourself low, leaving headroom for a vertical graphic or text behind your head.

**Looks like:** You sit in the lower 60%, and above your head a vertical image, card or title (sometimes behind your head via a cut-out) changes every couple of seconds.

**Good at:** show and tell at once; clean; premium with text behind the head

**Weak at:** must be framed correctly at the shoot; graphics to prepare

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, saves · effort medium

**How:** Tripod higher, shot wider; overlays in CapCut; text behind the head with a segmentation cut-out (HyperFrames or CapCut auto cut-out).

**Backed by:** [Frame low, leave headroom for graphics](../topics/filming.md#film-framed-graphic-headroom), [Text behind your head](../topics/effects.md#l10-text-behind-head), [Tool card lands on the word](../topics/text.md#l10-card-on-the-word), [Graphic yap: one overlay every ~2 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-graphic-yap-overlay-2s), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face) · sources L06, L10

## Split: graphic top, face bottom
<a id="split-screen"></a>

The top half or ~55% shows an animated graphic or example; your face is underneath; full face for key lines.

**Looks like:** A URL bar animates at the top while you explain below; for the punchline you go full frame. Or wrong form on top, right form below.

**Good at:** teaching; always something to look at; sound-off friendly

**Weak at:** the face is small; graphics work for the top half

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gym, all · goals retention, saves · effort medium

**How:** CapCut canvas split, or a HyperFrames top-half composition over the face clip.

**Backed by:** [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face), [Uppercase caption bar between halves](../topics/text.md#text-uppercase-caption-bar), [Gym: wrong vs right split-screen tip](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-gym-wrong-vs-right), [Frame low, leave headroom for graphics](../topics/filming.md#film-framed-graphic-headroom), [Content funnel: top, middle, bottom](../topics/growth.md#growth-content-funnel) · sources L01, R1, L04, SP

## Content card plus circular face cam
<a id="card-pip"></a>

A screen recording or source card fills most of the frame with your face in a small circle (PiP).

**Looks like:** A dark rounded card shows the app or article with a yellow highlight; your face sits in a ringed circle bottom-centre with an app badge.

**Good at:** tutorials; proof; face stays present

**Weak at:** the face is small; screen footage must be crisp

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches tech, gaming · goals saves, trust · effort medium

**How:** CapCut mask (circle) on the face clip over the screen recording; HyperFrames for rounded cards and shadows.

**Backed by:** [Screen content with a circular face cam](../topics/editing.md#edit-screen-card-circle-facecam), [Pause-and-play breakdown of a reel](../topics/ideas.md#l10-pause-and-play-breakdown), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face), [View-count pill on every example](../topics/effects.md#l11-view-count-proof-pill), [Graphic yap: one overlay every ~2 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-graphic-yap-overlay-2s) · sources R1, L07, L10

## Full-screen content, no face
<a id="full-screen-content"></a>

The screen recording, native app interface, green-screen image or gameplay fills the frame; voice only.

**Looks like:** The real Instagram or Windows interface being tapped, result first. Or you in front of one green-screen image, talking.

**Good at:** native feel; clear demo; no on-camera nerves

**Weak at:** less personality; harder to build recognition

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches tech, gaming · goals saves, reach · effort low

**How:** iPhone screen recording or OBS; voiceover in Edits; green screen via CapCut background removal.

**Backed by:** [Show proof on screen](../topics/editing.md#edit-proof-inserts), [Formats working in Dec 2025](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-green-screen-beginners), [Real screenshot beats an AI mock-up](../topics/editing.md#l10-real-screenshot-not-mockup), [Type the real prompt on screen](../topics/text.md#l10-prompt-bar-on-screen), [Split layouts: graphic plus face](../topics/editing.md#edit-split-screen-graphic-face) · sources R1, L08, research

## Mixing
Rahul switches between full face, card plus PiP and meme cutaways every few seconds rather than holding one layout. L01 switches from split to full face for key lines.

## Rule of thumb
Personality: full face. Teaching with visuals: split or framed. Software and proof: card plus PiP. Demos with no camera: full-screen content.
